uslaw-usc-t2-s132a3:
Section 132a-3 of Title 2 lets the Librarian of Congress move money between budget categories. During fiscal year 2014 and any later year, the Librarian may transfer amounts appropriated for the year. The transfers run between the categories of appropriations provided by law for the Library of Congress.

Approval guards the power. Each transfer needs the approval of the Appropriations Committees of both the House and the Senate. A percentage cap limits each account as well. Not more than ten percent of the funds in any one category account for a year may be transferred out of it in total. The section sits in Chapter 5 of Title 2, on the Library of Congress. The hosted Code text is published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel, current through Public Law 119-134. The rule trades rigid lines for supervised flexibility.
